by.claim: The progressive-sync false-complete failure has no detection path at all. T-27949 shows the ApplicationSet reporting `status.applicationStatus` `Healthy` and the rollout complete while child Applications are `OutOfSync` with no sync operation created, and notes that ApplicationSet controller logs were at warn level so no progressive-sync transition logs were emitted. T-27846 confirms the missing instrumentation: the metrics that would answer 'my sync is not starting, why / which Applications is it waiting for?' are still only a proposal. So neither the status field, nor logs, nor metrics surface the condition — it is found by a person opening the child Application.

T-26271's root cause was established on the platform sync call — with impersonation enabled the diff runs as the destination service account, which does not hold `patch` on cluster-scoped resources — but the notes record that someone still needs to write it on the ticket, and the ticket itself still reasons from the broad cluster Secret credential and asks why the diff suddenly runs with a narrower identity. The diagnosis exists and the ticket does not carry it, so the reporter keeps chasing the cluster Secret and every future responder re-derives the same answer.
